source_balance_files.name: Conventions for Bushland, TX, Weighing Lysimeter Datasets.xlsx

interval_convention: Fixed UTC-06:00, without daylight-saving time. Each timestamp ends a 15-minute interval; 24:00 belongs to the source day that just ended.
aggregation: All 96 values required for each quantity. Solar shortwave is the sum of 15-minute mean W/m2 times 900 seconds / 1e6. Temperature/RH extrema are extrema of interval means, not instantaneous daily extremes. No values are filled or clipped.

untimed_source_cells.handling: Retained here; excluded from dated summaries.

comparison_kind: Consistency of related published rainfall representations; not independent observations or validation of an Agronaut model.
missing_model_inputs: Daily net radiation is absent; solar shortwave cannot replace it.
Daily instantaneous temperature/humidity extremes are not supplied by these interval means.
Crop calendar, applicable coefficients, initial soil state and an agreed evaluation protocol remain unassembled.
